assessments.reasoning: The title page identifies Colmerauer and Roussel's November 1992 manuscript. A fresh HTTP 200 response matched the registered complete PDF digest. Inspected the exact passage on physical page 2. The first paragraph connects automated theorem proving to natural language processing in Prolog's origins and describes using French to communicate and reason with a computer. This describes the research project that gave rise to Prolog. It is scoped to the authors’ historical account and its French example. The introduction's name-date claim and chronology are separate from the project aim. The paper later distinguishes Prolog's design from the application built with it.
